title: Revit Levels, Grids, Scope Boxes, and Reference Elements
purpose: Apply governed level, grid, scope-box, and reference-element practices in Revit while preserving S6 coordinate authority and keeping unconfirmed source naming/graphics examples noncanonical.
preconditions: The project datum/coordinate strategy is established under S6.
Approved level and grid identities or project datum schedule are available for the project context.

steps.name: Create and maintain governed levels
actions: Create levels from the approved project datum/elevation source.
Use stable, clear level names suitable for cross-discipline coordination and downstream use.
Do not change authoritative elevations locally without the governed coordination process.
validation: Level names and elevations match the approved project datum source.
No duplicate or unexplained level elevations/names exist.

steps.name: Create and maintain governed grids
actions: Create grids using the approved project grid/structural reference source.
Keep grid identity consistent across discipline models and linked coordination contexts.
Coordinate any grid change through the authoritative model/process before downstream synchronization.
validation: Grid identities and positions are consistent with the approved source.
No ad-hoc local grid offsets or competing grid systems are introduced without governance.

steps.name: Control datum graphics through governed display rules
actions: Use Object Styles and View Templates to control grid/level linework, bubbles, text, and visibility.
Do not promote source TODO graphics values into local standards.
validation: Datum graphics are controlled by governed template/style mechanisms.
Unexplained per-view datum graphics overrides are absent or documented.

steps.name: Use scope boxes and reference planes intentionally
actions: Use scope boxes to maintain consistent extents/crops where required.
Name and manage reference planes/scope boxes according to the governing naming rules and project scope.
Place only agreed reference elements on the applicable datum/reference workset where worksharing uses one.
validation: Scope boxes and reference planes have clear governed purpose and naming.
Modeled building geometry is not placed on a datum/reference-only workset.

outputs: Coordinated Revit datum/reference structure aligned with the governed spatial framework
future_dependencies: Governed scope-box naming catalogue where required
governance_notes: S6 remains authoritative for shared-coordinate and spatial-authority rules.
Source grid naming examples, scope-box patterns, and exact graphics values marked TODO/to-be-confirmed are not canonicalized.

provenance.source_title: Levels, Grids & Reference Standards - Revit Guidelines
provenance.migration_note: Normalized as L6 datum/reference implementation guidance subordinate to S4 naming and S6 spatial authority.
